newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 7.

text.p: The following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Friday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Nomura Securities Co Ltd executives admit giving profits to corporate clients in apparently irregular stock trading.
-- Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) panel's deregulation plan allows incorporated companies to enter farm and hospital businesses.
-- Leader of hostage takers in Lima says they will suspend dialogue on ending standoff.
-- Japanese Red Army suspects indicted in Beirut.
-- LDP administrative reform panel will urge government to slash land value tax to zero.
-- North Korean defector Hwang Jang Yop likely to leave China soon.
